task: Audit and design ONE consolidated SummonScout routing fix from the current parallel HEAD. Goal: stop iterative hotfixing and make Urbraun -> Feltaxi(master) -> remote summoner (e.g. Bolthyjal/Hyjal) reliable and observable. Preserve fail-closed safety: no routed invite when the provider cannot actually complete Ritual; no automatic retry after uncertain SEND; no payment/summon safety regression. Current known architecture/issues: fixed summoners and slave pairs; RouteReadinessPresence removes blocked providers from canonical F.providers; FleetCounter rolloutReady is sticky and GUI ACTIVE 4/4 is misleading; FallbackRouterHot has canonical R/X/A, but master-origin ACK handling is wrong unless side bridges catch it; RouteAckHubFix + FallbackRouterHubAckHot are overlapping ACK layers; route control uses ordinary WHISPER and earlier live tests hit server flood-control; 1.84 diagnostic showed cases where customer gets checking then immediate unavailable, meaning no provider selected/X not sent when provider is not route-ready. Required end-state: (1) one canonical route-ready model with per-provider service, enabled, slave readiness and reason; (2) master GUI/status shows CURRENT live routes READY/BLOCKED with reason, not sticky historical 4/4; (3) canonical FallbackRouter stores selected provider in pendingRoute and accepts A only from that exact provider; (4) remove/disable redundant ACK bridges once canonical fix is active; (5) transaction control transport must avoid burst with customer-facing whispers/background heartbeats, with deterministic spacing/queueing but ZERO automatic retry after uncertain send; (6) if no provider is route-ready, do not say generic unavailable without internal reason: master should log/display the blocked reason; (7) regression tests for Hyjal blocked without Hyjaluno+Hyjalonee, Hyjal ready with both slaves, full R->X->invite->A success, wrong/stale provider ACK rejected, timeout/flood path fail-closed; (8) keep WoW 1.12.1/Lua 5.0 compatibility and current canonical primitives. First return a concrete architecture + exact files/functions to change/delete/neutralize, migration plan from 1.84, and likely hidden hazards. Do not implement. We will implement only after your design review.
